child.name: Exp
child.desc: Exp(number):returns e raised to the power, where e = 2.71828183.

child.name: Fix
child.desc: Fix(number):returns the integer portion of a number. The fix function will return the first negative number that is greater than or equal to the expression.

child.name: Int
child.desc: Int(number):returns the integer portion of a number. The fix function will return the first negative number that is less than or equal to the expression.

child.name: Log
child.desc: Log(number):returns the natural logarithm of a number.

child.name: Sin
child.desc: Sin(angle):returns the sine of an angle.

child.name: Sqr
child.desc: Sqr(number):returns the square root of a number.

child.name: Tan
child.desc: Tan(angle):returns the tangent of an angle.
